title: Implement Smart VAT Engine priority flow, eligibility enforcement, and updated product-category dropdown

requirements.text: Update the VAT rate configuration so the app uses the provided country VAT rates (DE/FR/NL/PL/SE/IT/BE/AT/HU/ES/GB with GB zero=0) as the authoritative source for the smart VAT engine.
acceptanceCriteria: VAT rates used by the unified VAT calculation match the provided VAT_CONFIG values for all listed countries.
GB configuration includes standard=20, reduced=5, zero=0 and is used when seller country is UK/GB.

requirements.text: Implement the provided category eligibility database and use it in VAT calculations: UK zero-eligible list, UK reduced-eligible list, EU reduced-eligible list, and exempt categories list (exempt applies to all countries).
acceptanceCriteria: Eligibility lists exist as explicit lists (not keyword matching) and are used by the unified VAT calculation.
Exempt treatment is triggered when the selected product category is one of the exempt categories, regardless of country.

requirements.text: Amend the unified VAT engine to follow the exact priority order and behaviors specified: 1) Reverse Charge (only when vatCategory is reverse and transaction is B2B), 2) Export (if isExport is true), 3) Exempt (if productCategory is in exempt list), 4) Zero (UK only; if country is GB and productCategory is UK-zero eligible), 5) Reduced (UK reduced list when GB; EU reduced list otherwise), 6) Standard fallback.

quotes:
Reverse Charge
2. Export
3. Exempt
4. Zero (UK only)
5. Reduced
6. Standard (fallback)

acceptanceCriteria: For B2B + vatCategory=reverse, VAT result is 0% with label 'Reverse Charge' and this takes precedence over export/exempt/zero/reduced.
If isExport is true, VAT result is 0% with label 'Zero Rated Export' and takes precedence over exempt/zero/reduced/standard.
If productCategory is in EXEMPT_CATEGORIES, VAT result is 0% with label 'Exempt' and takes precedence over zero/reduced/standard.
If seller country is GB, zero-rating is only applied when productCategory is in UK_ZERO (not by manual selection alone).
Reduced VAT is only applied when productCategory is eligible (UK_REDUCED for GB; EU_REDUCED for non-GB).
All other cases return standard VAT for the configured country with label 'Standard VAT'.

requirements.text: Enforce auto-fallback protection: even if a user manually selects reduced/zero VAT categories, the VAT engine must automatically apply standard VAT whenever the selected product category is not eligible; no manual override is allowed.

quotes:
6️⃣ AUTO-FALLBACK PROTECTION (Prevents Misuse)
Even if user manually selects reduced:

If product not in eligibility list → automatically apply standard.

No manual override allowed.

acceptanceCriteria: Selecting reduced/zero VAT category in the UI does not change the final VAT result unless the selected product category is eligible under the configured lists.
The final VAT result returned by the engine cannot be forced to reduced/zero by user selection when the product category is ineligible.

requirements.text: Update the product category dropdown options to exactly match the requested UX list and keep prior dropdown rendering fixes intact (e.g., safe z-index/overflow classes and current dropdown behavior). The dropdown must include: Basic Food, Books, Medical, Transport, Hotel, Financial Services, Insurance, Education, Domestic Fuel (UK), Others.

quotes:
7️⃣ UX IMPROVEMENT
Dropdown:

• Basic Food
• Books
• Medical
• Transport
• Hotel
• Financial Services
• Insurance
• Education
• Domestic Fuel (UK)
• Others

acceptanceCriteria: The product category dropdown shows exactly the requested options (including the three exempt categories as selectable options).
Domestic Fuel (UK) is only shown when the selected country is GB/UK.
Existing dropdown usability fixes are preserved (no regressions to clipping/overlay issues).

requirements.text: Implement the UI/logic rule: when productCategory is 'Others', the VAT result must always be Standard VAT (even if the user selected reduced/zero in the VAT category/treatment controls).

quotes:
Logic:

If productCategory = "Others"
→ Always Standard VAT

acceptanceCriteria: When 'Others' is selected, the engine returns standard VAT for the seller country and label 'Standard VAT' regardless of any VAT category/treatment selection.

requirements.text: Use the provided result builder output fields for VAT computation outputs (rate, vatAmount, total, label) and ensure the UI/invoice continues to display consistent results derived from these values.
acceptanceCriteria: VAT calculation produces values consistent with: vatAmount=(netAmount*rate)/100 and total=netAmount+vatAmount.
The displayed VAT rate/amount/total and the stored invoice values match the engine output.

requirements.text: Ensure professional invoice wording auto-switch uses the provided logic for Reverse Charge (localized for DE/FR/IT/GB with fallback) and English text for Exempt / Zero Rated / Reduced VAT / Standard VAT, based on the VAT label returned by the engine.
acceptanceCriteria: When the VAT label is 'Reverse Charge', the invoice legal wording uses DE/FR/IT/GB specific text when available, otherwise the fallback 'Reverse charge applies'.
When the VAT label is 'Exempt', 'Zero Rated', 'Reduced VAT', or 'Standard VAT', the invoice legal wording matches the provided English sentences.
Invoice wording selection is driven by the VAT label returned from the calculation (not by user-entered free text unless an explicit override is already part of the app).

requirements.text: Add the global legal disclaimer text to all generated invoices: "VAT calculated based on selected country, product category and transaction type. The supplier is responsible for verifying compliance with applicable VAT legislation."

quotes:
8️⃣ GLOBAL LEGAL DISCLAIMER (Add To All Invoices)
VAT calculated based on selected country, product category and transaction type. The supplier is responsible for verifying compliance with applicable VAT legislation."

acceptanceCriteria: Every invoice HTML output includes the disclaimer text verbatim in English.
The disclaimer is present regardless of VAT scenario (reverse charge/export/exempt/zero/reduced/standard).

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text in these changes.
Respect the existing frontend immutable paths; do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or the Internet Identity/actor hooks listed as immutable.
Keep the previously implemented dropdown behavior/fixes; do not reintroduce clipping/stacking issues.
nonGoals: Do not add new authentication providers (Internet Identity remains the only auth).
Do not add external databases or third-party backends for VAT rules.
